_meta.purpose: Horizontal coverage — make the Position surfaces actually render. ADDITIVE; references S1/S2 by seed_key.
_meta.why: PositionSection rollup is min-n gated at 10. HB-14 had only 9 citizen positions (officials' stances went to votes.metadata, not entity_positions), so the rollup was hidden. This adds positions to cross 10, plus the two unexercised position features: conditions_md (conditional support) and a persuasion DELTA.
_meta.LOADER CHANGES REQUIRED: (1) read optional `conditions` → entity_positions.conditions_md. (2) support a `deltas` block: seed an initial position then a changed position attributed to a comment (set_entity_position with p_attributed_comment_id, or seed position_events with attributed_comment_id) so the comment's rating_summary.deltas increments. Guards: author ≥7d old (all synthetic seed users predate this), prior position required.

positions.author: cit-gradstudentgus
positions.statement: The plateau's kids and the climate both lose if we stall. Build it, fund the transition, done.

positions.author: cit-transittina
positions.statement: Watauga needs the power and the plateau needs the jobs. This is the rare bill that does both.

positions.author: cit-hillcountryhal
positions.conditions: Yes IF the decommissioning bond and a real cost cap are both in. Otherwise it's a future liability dressed as progress.
positions.statement: Conditional. Put the cleanup money up front, not just the construction money.

positions.author: cit-fifthstreetcafe
positions.conditions: Support as long as Title IV's cost cap survives to the final vote — strip the cap and I'm off it.
positions.statement: My shop runs on that grid. I'm in, with the cap.

deltas.author: cit-farmbureaufran
deltas.note: The showcase persuasion delta: FarmBureauFran came in opposed to HB-09, then OldGrowthOwen's B-3 comment ('a guaranteed minimum in-stream flow protects YOUR water in a drought year too') changed her mind to conditional. Her position S2 record (pos-hb09-fran) is the resulting 'mixed' stance; this records the CHANGE and attributes it to B-3, so B-3's rating_summary.deltas increments and the debate map shows a comment that measurably moved someone.
